tools.name: get_login_stats
tools.description: Overall login security summary for your team: total checks, average risk score, high-risk count, blocked/failed logins, and bot/Tor/VPN counts. Supports filtering by browser, OS, country, device, user and time window.

tools.name: get_average_risk_score
tools.description: Average login risk score (0-10) across matching logins. Use the filters to answer questions like "what is my average login risk score for the chrome browser".

tools.name: get_login_breakdown
tools.description: Group logins by a dimension (browser, os, device, country, or status) and return counts, average risk score and high-risk counts per group. Good for "which browser has the highest risk".

tools.name: get_recent_logins
tools.description: List the most recent login checks (newest first) with risk score, status, location and device. Supports the same filters.

tools.name: get_account_usage
tools.description: Your LoginLlama account usage: remaining API credits for production and staging, and plan name.
